in_marathi.name: Hrishitaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Hrishikesh's wish fulfilled
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrishitaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hrishitaa is derived from the Sanskrit words Hrishikesh and Itaas, meaning 'Goddess Hrishikesh's wish fulfilled'. Hrishikesh is a name of Lord Vishnu and is associated with the Ganges River, representing the divine power that fulfills all wishes.
